zones.sun: ≥20° SE/S/SW-facing inclines — warmer, sunnier sun pockets
zones.cool: ≥20° NW/N/NE-facing inclines — far less direct sun, cooler & shaded
zones.wind: Wind-prone areas for the prevailing W/NW flow — open coast fringe, windward W/NW faces, exposed crests, wind gaps open to the west, the Golden Gate strait, and the Van Ness/Market high-rise corridor
zones.fog: Fog path — ≤200 ft low ground connected to the west coast that marine fog threads east through
zones.fog2: Fog band 200–350 ft — fog laps this far up the slopes, thinning
zones.fog3: Fog band 350–500 ft — fog reaches here only on the windward side
zones.fog4: Fog band 500–1000 ft — fog crests here at most; usually above the fog
